text_block_list.text: Heading into the Tenno Sho (Spring), Symboli Rudolf continued her rigorous training while adapting to adjustments different from anything before.

Still, now that she's reached the Senior Class and her
reputation in the Umamusume world is growing,
she has a mountain of things to do—

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then, to conclude,
could you give us a final word about your plans for the future?”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I will polish my strength even further and forge ahead to stand at the pinnacle of all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As the "Emperor", I ask that you do not blink,
and continue to capture my stride with your camera.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I shall deliver results that exceed all of your expectations.
That is all."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A (Female)
text_block_list.text:
What a dignified comment, as expected!
We will continue cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, next up is the TV station interview, right?
I might have packed the schedule a bit too tight.

Now one of the star Umamusume,
Symboli Rudolf was flooded with interview requests daily.

"Taking this as proof of the Umamusume world's booming excitement,
she gleefully busies herself and manages it all with a cool face, but..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us hurry to the track.
This upcoming interview is of great importance to the Academy as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us make great use of it
for public relations purposes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's a surprise. Look forward to it,
my dear Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—That concludes our brief tour
of the academy's facilities.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We are always accepting visitors, so if you are
interested, please feel free to apply.

text_block_list.name: TV Station Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
I see... Aside from the official campus tours,
is there any other way to get a feel for the academy's atmosphere?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it has already been arranged.
In fact, it is scheduled to be held on a grand scale in the coming days."

text_block_list.name: TV Station Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
What in the world is that!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —It's the "Fan Thanksgiving Festival."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Every spring, our academy holds an athletic event where our Umamusume
can interact with everyone who supports them, but—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This year, we will expand the event even further
and present it as the 'Grand Fan Appreciation Festival.'

text_block_list.name: TV Station Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~!
Specifically, how will it be expanded?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“Not only an increase in events, but also volunteer presentations,
talk shows featuring alumni, and more...”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We shall also prepare
a diverse variety of content
for everyone to enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"We shall make it an event that everyone can enjoy,
both regular racegoers and newcomers alike."

text_block_list.name: TV Station Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
I see, that sounds exciting~!
By the way, Symboli Rudolf-san, do you
plan on doing anything yourself?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As student council president,
I plan to patrol during the event. Aside from that—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will be participating in the exhibition race,
the main attraction at the end of the event.
choice_data_list: (…!? This is the first I've heard of it!)

text_block_list.name: TV Station Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Goodness! Symboli Rudolf-san is?!
Now I'm looking forward to this even more!

text_block_list.name: TV Station Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please be sure to join us
for Tracen Academy's 'Fan Appreciation Festival'!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I won't let you call my arrival a "miscalculation."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Please come and see the amazing Umamusume
our academy takes pride in compete together."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Phew.
That wraps up today's interview schedule.
choice_data_list: So you're entering the exhibition race?
Are you entering the exhibition race?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I had proposed it a while back,
and it was officially decided just the other day."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Though it's billed as an exhibition,
I want it to be the centerpiece race of the Fan Appreciation Festival.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's why the event is scheduled toward the end. We've gathered some truly wonderful runners for it, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If the "Emperor" joins the fray as well,
it will become even more thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I can contribute to the success of the event...
then that is why I decided to participate as well.
choice_data_list: I wish you'd told me sooner!

text_block_list.text:
Even if it's an exhibition, a race is a race.
I told her that I adjusted the training plan
so she could display her maximum performance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the offer, but I intend to act
in accordance with the current plan you've drawn up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No need for any adjustments.

Even so, it doesn't change the fact that Symboli Rudolf will still have to push herself to the brink.
As her Trainer, I simply cannot overlook that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Trainer-kun.
I appreciate your concern.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the same token, however,
there's something I'd like to ask of you too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Telling me to believe in myself more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not right.
Maybe even that was a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, making them anxious
is proof enough that I am unworthy of their trust.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —That's what Air Groove wanted to point out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, President.
You are mistaken...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"—More, more, far more than now.
I must work with even greater, soul-rending devotion."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I must show them what it means to be the "Emperor."
Otherwise, no one would ever want to follow me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I haven't even touched the shadow of my ideal yet.
I need to stack up more victories and achievements.

...Though she is speaking with strong conviction,
she somehow looks like she's struggling to breathe.
choice_data_list: Did you talk things through with Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...No, she's also quite busy
with the Fan Appreciation Festival."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The challenge was thrown down,
and I grasped the answer."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...In the exhibition race, I will deliver a performance that convinces everyone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I cannot afford to fail
in front of such a massive crowd.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Just when the Umamusume world is getting so hyped, we can't go throwing cold water on it with a crushing defeat.

Her muttering as she drove herself to the brink
sounded painfully heartbreaking—

text_block_list.name: Student Council Officer
text_block_list.text: Ah! President, there you are! There are a few things I need to confirm about the event.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's go now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Pardon me, but I must take my leave.

"...What is it that I can do?
It made me stop and reconsider once more."
